_comment: Test fixture for the extensibility gate: a DIFFERENT number of entries than the bundled default (five, not three) and five DIFFERENT types (convention, glossary, decision, constraint, status), including four that are not 'convention'. A suite that only ever sees three conventions proves nothing about extensibility; every extensibility test runs against this.

entries.content: Example convention entry alpha — a reversible working norm.

entries._comment: a glossary entry — NOT a convention
entries.content: Example glossary term — a definition served under type=glossary only.
Example decision entry — a ratified choice served under type=decision only.
Example constraint entry — a durable binding rule served under type=constraint only.
Example status entry — the current steering state served under type=status only.
